members.name: date
members.doc: Day of the close as YYYY-MM-DD.

types.name: PriceTargetFanProps
types.doc: A price history that fans out into analyst targets: the line draws up to the last close, then three dashed lines open toward the high, median and low targets, each ending in a label with its price and distance from today. Hover or focus a label to bring its scenario forward; scrub the history with the pointer or the arrow keys to read past closes.

members.name: history
members.doc: Price history, one point per close. Any order: the chart sorts by date.

members.name: targets
members.doc: The three targets at the end of the horizon.

members.name: label
members.doc: Accessible name of the chart, such as "Northwind price and 12-month analyst targets".

members.name: targetDate
members.doc: Day the targets refer to, as YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to one year after the last close.

members.name: currency
members.doc: Currency code used by the default price format.

members.name: formatValue
members.doc: Formats a price. Defaults to the currency format of the locale.

members.name: height
members.doc: Height of the chart in px, time axis included.

members.name: activeTarget
members.doc: Scenario brought forward, or null for none. Leave undefined to let the chart keep its own.

members.name: defaultActiveTarget
members.doc: Scenario brought forward at first when the chart keeps its own.

members.name: onActiveTargetChange
members.doc: Called when a target label is clicked: with its key, or null when the active one is clicked again.

members.name: locale
members.doc: Formatting locale. Fixed by default so server and client render the same labels.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class for the root element.
